official_statement_rationale: The headline CPI inflation at 7.44 per cent is significantly above the upper tolerance band, driven primarily by a sharp 11.51 per cent spike in food inflation. While core inflation has moderated to 4.90 per cent, the risks to the inflation outlook remain elevated, particularly given the 5.0 per cent monsoon rainfall deficit which could exacerbate food price pressures. Given the resilience in GVA growth at 7.80 per cent, the current policy repo rate of 6.50 per cent remains appropriate to balance the growth-inflation trade-off. However, in view of the persistent inflationary risks and the need to ensure that inflation expectations remain anchored, I vote for maintaining the status quo on the policy rate and continuing with the stance of withdrawal of accommodation.
